at.description: when the desktop fades in (default), or right at the start

whenHeadless.description: played in the headless backend too (default false)

players.description: the players tried in order (default pw-play, paplay, aplay)

playerTimeoutMillis.description: how long a player may play before it is stopped (default 30000)

startupSound.description: a sound when the session starts
